rules.statement: The cause of action for a claim in reconvention by a purchaser does not arise until the vendor takes steps to eject the purchaser from his possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "it is obvious that if the cause of action is held to have accrued at the date of the deed a door would be opened wide for fraud. The grantor of a non-notarial conveyance would only have to wait for three years to enable him to avoid the conveyance without being made responsible for the refund of the purchase money."
